artifacts.authored_text:
COMMISSION 14 — MARA VENN
The refuge register does not agree with the works file. Before I release the Commons seal, establish the public road, the building campaigns, the supported refuge places, and the reason for the down-cut. I left one findings ledger on the Intake counter. Enter one clause under each heading, then lodge the whole report. Returned papers are not marked by section. Once endorsed, add the account that all four findings support.
